notes: SOURCE: docs/plans/model-plane-chat-build-plan-2026-10-14.md lines 1441-1485 (WS27 section, slice table at 1456-1469, dependency and edit-order text at 1471-1475) with Appendix B (binding, lines 2253-2322) applied. PATH MAP: MP = apps/Model Plane; RS = apps/Model Plane/rust/services; MG = RS/model-gateway/src (MG/tests = RS/model-gateway/tests); IC = RS/inference-core/src; EC = RS/execution-core/src; SC = RS/session-core/src; FE = apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3. CC in the WS27 section is COST-CORE (apps/Model Plane/go/services/cost-core), not capability-core as the extraction brief said; capability-core is a separate service in the same tree. Plan line numbers are stale in this worktree (for example RichEventSink is in sse_events.rs at 780, PlanProposed at sse_events.rs 320, follow_agentic_run at sse.rs 9740, build_usage_envelope at sse.rs 10661, DirectAnswer at sse.rs 7697); paths carry no line numbers, so re-locate by symbol. Bare workstream ids (WS01, WS03, WS10, WS11, WS13, WS14) are used where the plan names no slice. APPENDIX B APPLIED: (1) N4: RunUsageProgress is tag 29, not 27 (27 and 28 are QuestionAsked and QuestionAnswered in the section 4.3 final list), applied to WS27-S9. (2) N2: WS12-S2 added to the depends of the two proto-editing slices WS27-S7 and WS27-S9; their proof is a tag-number diff against git show HEAD, and buf breaking is not to be recorded as passing unless the gate is verified. (3) K3-19: WS27-S11 is optional, unscheduled and excluded from effort (its table effort 3-4 d is kept). The appendix total of 40-58 days does not match the slice figures: S0-S10 sum to 40-59 days; with S11 the sum is 43-63, while the section header says about 43-62. Reported, not corrected. (4) N1: WS27-S0 changes no runtime behaviour (ADR, ledger, characterisation tests), so its evidence is CI; other slices keep rebuilt-stack evidence. (5) N6 and N7: no migration and no new durable session-core mutation in WS27 (RunUsageProgress is counts only and is not persisted), so no revert file and no ZDR-inventory row. (6) N8(c): zdr-contract-sync.test.sh is at scripts/tests at the repository root. BUILD STATE (this worktree, HEAD 12dd8cb7, branch model-plane): git log afb83928..HEAD has no WS27 commit. NOT BUILT (absent): usage_meter.rs, run_ceiling.rs, cost_bound.rs, usage_meter_contract.rs, budget_window_test.go, RunCostMeter.tsx and its test, billing-quota.ts in actions and in api, chat-cost-meter.spec.ts. Also absent: any usage_progress or UsageProgress ChatEvent, RouteNote, RunUsageProgress, record_overhead, a ToolRounds usage field (tool_loop.rs ToolRounds at 4581), DirectAnswer cache fields, a since field in the cost-core budget check, reset_period reads, the pricing Lookup enum, priced, CategoryCost or RateSnapshot, the WS27 ledger entry, the ZDR.md in-stream line, a billing.quota action or getBillingQuota, VITE_QUOTA_READOUT, and every WS27 env flag in apps/Model Plane/deploy/docker-compose.yml. HEADER LABEL: the header tags S0, S1, S2, S5 and S8 as FINISH-BUILT-BUT-DARK, but none of their named artifacts exists in this worktree; tags are kept as written, and the built label may refer to uncommitted work in the main checkout, which was not inspected (outside this worktree). REUSABLE NOW: WS02-S1 cache keys are on the usage frame (sse_events.rs ChatEvent::Usage writes cache_read_tokens and cache_write_tokens when either is non-zero; sse.rs fills them), so S2 and S3 must reuse them, and the plan line saying ChatEvent::Usage has no cache fields is stale. Also present as call sites: RichEventSink (sse_events.rs), follow_agentic_run (sse.rs), build_usage_envelope (sse.rs, no run_id parameter yet), event_run_id (session-core orchestration_grpc.rs), publish_plan_transition (execution-core runtime_loop/agent.rs), count_for_budget (apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-tokens/src/lib.rs), PlanProposed (sse_events.rs), pricing cost_usd_for, cost_from_rate and the cache-leg tests, budget.rs and org_quota.rs. PROTO TAGS: InferResponse provider_timing = 14 and InferChunk provider_timing = 15 exist, so route_note 15 (InferResponse) and 16 (InferChunk) are free; OrchestrationEvent run_parked = 24 and run_resumed = 25 exist; 26-29 are free, and 29 is the WS27 tag. BLOCKERS NOT BUILT: WS02-S3 is not built (no UsageTally; RunAgentResponse in execution.proto at line 273 has no usage field), so WS27-S9 cannot land before it. WS11-S5 is not built (no effort allowance function, no RouteNote); the plan says the first lander defines RouteNote, so WS27-S7 may define it only if the integrator agrees, and WS27-S11 waits for effort::allowance. WS12-S2: apps/Model Plane/proto/baseline.binpb is 530476 bytes in this worktree (N2 says 0 bytes at HEAD), and commit e45caa71 (make the buf breaking gate real) is in the proto path history, so the buf gate may now be real; not verified further. [L] MARKERS: zdr_features.rs, zdr_posture.rs, zdr_feature_table.rs and zdr_posture_matrix.rs exist in this worktree (ZDR wave, commit d6c8e557), so [L] is not a missing-file signal here. RULES APPLIED: (a) The WS27 edit-order text puts WS09-S2 first for chat-client.ts, use-chat-controller.ts, ChatMessages.tsx and ChatPanels.tsx, so WS09-S2 is in the depends of WS27-S2 and WS27-S3 as a soft dependency (it is not in their Deps column). (b) WS27-S11 is built only after S2-S4 produce per-run data (its row). (c) DEC-18 gates enablement only; builds proceed (decision register row 16). (d) Any slice that adds or flips a flag also touches apps/Model Plane/deploy/docker-compose.yml (common flag pattern). (e) files = Change-column paths plus NEW test files named in Tests or DoD; existing tests to extend (zdr_feature_table.rs, zdr_posture_matrix.rs, chat-client.test.ts, use-chat-controller.recovery.test.ts, ChatMessages.metrics.test.tsx, AgentRunConsole.test.tsx, verevon-ui-events.test.ts) appear only in test_commands. (f) WS27-S10 billing.rs change is conditional on product wanting a trimmed projection. (g) The S11 plan-card component is not named in the plan, so no FE file is listed for it. (h) Go regeneration: S7 writes apps/Model Plane/go/gen/model_plane/v1/inference.pb.go and S9 writes orchestration.pb.go; the _grpc.pb.go files are not expected to change for field additions. (i) cost-core store_integration_test.go (WS27-S8) needs COST_CORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL. COMMON CHECKS for every WS27 slice (not repeated per slice): cd apps/Model Plane/rust && cargo fmt --all -- --check, then cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib (also inference-core, execution-core and session-core --lib); cd apps/Model Plane/go/services/cost-core && go test ./... && go vet ./...; python3 apps/Model Plane/scripts/gen-sse-event-taxonomy.py --check after every ChatEvent change; in FE: pnpm vitest run, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint; cargo test --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets; node --test apps/gateway/scripts/action-surface-contract.test.mjs. For proto slices the tag-diff evidence replaces buf breaking, per N2.

slices.title: Land ADR, characterise the run-cost meter
slices.summary: Records the WS27 ledger entries (one run-cost meter in model-gateway with cost-core as ledger of record; cost null when unknown, never a default row; ZDR in-stream cost proposed; per-run ceiling vs windowed budget) and the capability-ownership row, and adds a characterisation test file that pins today's unmetered tool rounds and default-row pricing so later slices flip them.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --test usage_meter_contract

slices.title: Honest pricing primitives and pure UsageMeter
slices.summary: Adds PricingCache::priced, which returns usd None for a catalogue default row instead of a confident wrong cost, a category cost breakdown whose parts sum to the total, and a pure UsageMeter that nulls the total once any metered call is unpriced; subscription calls add tokens but no USD. No wire change.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --lib pricing usage_meter

slices.title: Count tool rounds and overhead; cumulative final frame
slices.summary: Meters tool-decision rounds and overhead calls that are never counted today and folds them with the answer into one turn-cumulative final usage frame (the cumulative frame ships ungated); adds calls, unpriced_calls and cost_by_category to the usage event; under MODEL_GATEWAY_TURN_USAGE_COMPLETE publishes one usage envelope per round stamped with run_id so the cost-core run endpoint is non-empty for chat. Reuses the WS02-S1 cache keys already on the frame.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_TURN_USAGE_COMPLETE (default false; the cumulative final frame is ungated)
slices.needs_external: Control Plane confirms billing attribution for metered tool rounds (DEC-18 D5) before MODEL_GATEWAY_TURN_USAGE_COMPLETE is enabled; the ledger total jumps on enablement

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --test usage_meter_contract

slices.title: usage_progress frame, gateway to SPA parse
slices.summary: Adds a usage_progress ChatEvent with closed keys only (call count, phase, token counts, cost_usd or null, cost_basis, unpriced_calls; ceiling and routing keys come later), emitted once per provider call from RichEventSink, parsed by the BFF and the SPA; the final usage frame remains the terminal authority. Gated by MODEL_GATEWAY_USAGE_PROGRESS.
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_USAGE_PROGRESS (default false until the S4 DoD, then true)

cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && cargo test --manifest-path apps/gateway/Cargo.toml --all-targets

slices.title: SPA run-cost meter
slices.summary: Adds the RunCostMeter component to the work panel and the agent run console, fed by usage_progress with a monotonic guard: it shows tokens in and out, the cache read share when non-zero, a cost or 'price unavailable' or 'included in subscription' (never $0), the last call phase and an expandable breakdown by category; a warning chip announces through aria-live only when the warning changes. Flips the progress flag default to true at DoD.
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/components/RunCostMeter.test.tsx ChatMessages.metrics.test.tsx src/features/agents/components/AgentRunConsole.test.tsx
playwright tests/e2e/chat-cost-meter.spec.ts (runner command not named in the plan)

slices.title: ZDR in-stream cost
slices.summary: Gives ZDR answer turns a stated cost in-stream: DirectAnswer carries the cache read and write counts, zdr_answer_stream takes a value pre-priced in zdr_direct_stream (numbers only, nothing stored, no usage envelope, no ledger row), and a new test zdr_usage_states_cost_but_publishes_no_envelope in zdr_posture_matrix.rs pins it. The ZDR feature-table comment and ZDR.md are updated so the ledger gap stays explicit (DEF-Z-06b).

slices.title: Per-run ceiling, 80/100% warnings, optional enforcement
slices.summary: Adds RunCeiling resolution (request cap wins, org limits fill unset, token cap counts metered tokens only, subscription exempt) with the warnings run_ceiling_80 and run_ceiling_reached, each emitted once per run and attached to usage_progress. With MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CEILING_ENFORCE on, the tool phase ends before the next round once the ceiling is reached and the answer still streams; the meter shows a ceiling bar.

slices.title: Surface the silent budget downgrade
slices.summary: Adds a RouteNote message (budget_posture, tier_shifted, cheap_fallback_forced, applied_effort) as InferResponse.route_note = 15 and InferChunk.route_note = 16, stamped in inference-core fallback after intent resolution and copied through the gateway, which sets routing tier_shifted or cheap_fallback on usage_progress only when the posture is Constrained or Exhausted; the SPA shows one calm line. Gated by INFERENCE_ROUTE_NOTE. The message is shared with WS11.
slices.needs_external: Integrator confirms tags InferResponse.route_note = 15 and InferChunk.route_note = 16 (DEC-39, section 4.3 final); the shared RouteNote owner is WS11

cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p inference-core --test fallback_test

slices.title: Windowed org budget
slices.summary: Makes the cost-core budget check window-aware: an optional since timestamp (RFC 3339) on the budget check, with per-user and org-wide totals read through the ledger's existing Since filter; the gateway reads reset_period from the org quota row and sends the UTC window start (daily or monthly; none sends nothing), so a capped org is admitted again next period. Absent since keeps lifetime behaviour. Gated by MODEL_GATEWAY_BUDGET_WINDOW; cost-core must deploy before the gateway.
slices.needs_external: Control confirms the windowed semantics (DEC-18 D2) before the gate changes behaviour for capped orgs; Control owns the reset_period rule in org-core
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/go/services/cost-core" && go test ./...
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p model-gateway reset_period_daily_sends_start_of_utc_day

slices.title: Do-run per-round progress
slices.summary: Streams cumulative per-round usage for Do runs: adds RunUsageProgress (counts and ids only, not persisted) as OrchestrationEvent tag 29, published best-effort from execution-core after each round and passed through session-core's event broadcast; the gateway's follow_agentic_run maps it to usage_progress with a snapshot priced once. The final usage comes from RunAgentResponse.usage (WS02-S3). Gated by EXECUTION_RUN_USAGE_PROGRESS.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_RUN_USAGE_PROGRESS (default false; deploy execution-core and session-core before the gateway)

slices.title: Member quota readout
slices.summary: Adds a member-visible allowance line: a billing.quota.read action contract registered beside billing.allowances.read, a typed client over the existing BFF route GET /api/v1/billing/quotas/{metric} that parses QuotaStatus (limit, used, remaining, is_exceeded, utilization), and a secondary RunCostMeter line that warns at utilization 0.8 or when exceeded, labelled as organisation-wide. No model-gateway change; per-user allowance is out of scope.
slices.flag: VITE_QUOTA_READOUT (name not fixed by the plan; default off)
slices.needs_external: Control billing-core owner: the allowance metric name (WS27-D9, org-configured) and whether non-admins see a coarse projection only

slices.title: Plan-card upper bound (gated, not scheduled)
slices.summary: Adds an optional labelled upper bound to the plan proposal (PlanProposed.cost_bound with max_usd, max_tokens, rounds and basis upper_bound), computed from the run budget's max rounds times context tokens and a per-round output ceiling widened by the WS11 effort allowance; max_usd is null when the model is unpriced or the route is subscription. The plan card shows it as an upper bound, never as cost. Gated by MODEL_GATEWAY_PLAN_COST_BOUND.
